COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01 — NEW scoped decision for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles only. This does not change ordinary Ready, ordinary class spell cadence, the Mirrorsage class Echo implementation, any profile's payload or any acquisition predicate.

PREPARATION. A direct feat-copy cast retains its current commitment-round allowance rule. A Readied feat-copy also requires the owner's feat-copy allowance in its actual preparation numbered round. If this owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds feat copies, require that same round's actual class allowance as well; an ability route alone never invents the engine. Validate all presently required setup predicates first. At one authoritative legal preparation commitment, atomically spend the Action, quote/payment, permission/use, feat-copy round allowance and any required actually owned class allowance, provide components, update the independent feat-copy chronological family/strain exactly once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden. These spends occur before the preparation counter window. Either all required allowance/resources are valid before commitment or no new setup spend occurs; a partial class/feat-ledger reservation is forbidden. A countered, replaced, expired or concentration-lost preparation retains its actual committed spends. It cannot refund the consumed Mimicry use, restore displaced concentration or free that preparation round for another copy. A genuinely failed precommit validation is not a paid preparation.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID, actual owner, fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, paid transaction and consumed permission receipt, preparation round, affected ledger identities, original Ready expiry and any independently applicable earlier source/capture deadline. A new valid Ready may replace it only under ordinary Ready; an illegal replacement attempt cannot delete it. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but this completion does not extend a printed earlier capture/use/hold deadline or create a new permission. No allowance in a future round is reserved ahead of time. No payload or success-triggered effect has happened merely because setup was paid. Capture validity, source component availability and upstream providers still require their actual existing records; this decision is not a missing-source adapter.

RELEASE. After a real perceivable trigger has completed and before the Ready's original expiry, perform the ordinary release legality check, including an actually available lawful Reaction and all applicable source/target/geometry predicates. Check the ACTUAL RELEASE numbered round's feat-copy allowance and any actually required class shared-release allowance. In the same numbered round as preparation, reuse only this same held preparation's already-spent allowance tokens, not another copy's tokens. In a later numbered round, both applicable release-round allowances must be free and are atomically spent together with the Reaction when this release commits. The preparation-round spends are not moved, refunded or reclassified. Thus cross-round Ready deliberately occupies one attempt allowance in each touched round, but pays RP, capture permission, components, strain and casting history only once. This is the selected conservative timing choice, not a claim that the prior source already specified it. It prevents both preparation spam after a counter and a deferred copy plus a competing copy bypassing the release-round cap. An unowned class engine is still not granted.

If the trigger is declined, target is invalid, an actual prerequisite is missing or either required release-round allowance is unavailable, do not spend the Reaction or partially debit another ledger; keep the existing held record only until another lawful occurrence before its original expiry. Supply no hidden-target or item-identification diagnostic. A genuinely permitted competing direct copy or class release may use its available round allowance first; holding a prior-round copy gives no priority or override. If nothing legal can release before expiry, the hold is lost normally. At the exact expiry boundary, expiry occurs first.

On a valid release commitment, consume the hold once before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, source-permission consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, ordinary cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Later prevention of that committed payload does not refund the Reaction or release-round allowances. Replay/retry of the same release ID cannot create another payload or another spend. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step releases end the Ready concentration after resolution. Sustained Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden with their real effect clock and earlier source limits; there is no second slot. Save/load must preserve the complete hold identity, original expiry, consumed receipts, chronology and per-owner/per-numbered-round ledger entries. Extra turns, reloading, relabeling a round, changing a qualifying route or swapping captured profile names cannot reset them. This settles only allowance/transaction timing; complete Ready scheduling, perception, source-specific payloads and live engine behavior still require implementation and tests.

For original rank 0, q=0; otherwise q=max(1, floor(originalRank/2)). The chosen actual owned spellcasting route must independently support learning q; merely owning a pool or feat prerequisite does not. Use that route’s real ability for attack/DC and spell components V/S, normal rank price 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 plus actual adjustments. It grants a temporary feat-copy route only, never the original full spell. Spellcasting time is oneAction. For a direct Action release, pay/cast/history/interrupt once at commitment, with copy-provenance flags disabling copy/resource/class-proc chains. For a legal Ready, that one casting/payment/history/counter transaction occurs at preparation; its later Reaction release is not a second cast. Apply COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01 for the separately enforced preparation-round and, if different, release-round allowance checks. An explicit source such as Mirrorsage retains its own actual profile/rank/payment instead of being silently converted. FINAL FS-08: these releases are paid feat-copy casts with actual RP/components/history, not ordinary knowledge grants. Boon uses one feat-copy-boon family; its repeated copies do not add, while genuinely distinct eligible ordinary feat bonuses use FS-03.

At most one feat-copy release per owner per numbered round across Eldritch Echo, Mimicry and adapted copies. A Mirrorsage owner also spends its existing shared release allowance; an unowned Mirrorsage engine is not granted. Strike/Burst/Mend/Step are immediate. Ward/Hindrance/Boon use their stated maximum two-interval duration; source-specific shorter hold deadlines still govern. Only one pending feat-copy record across Eldritch Echo/Mimicry; before a new capture choose whether to replace the old, losing its paid capture/use without refund. Adaptation may retain permission but creates no second release allowance. No copied effect grants extra Action/BA/Reaction, persistent body, loot, learning or concentration capacity.

NEW NWQ-02 activation: no verbal, somatic, focus, material, command-word or audible channel is required by the technique itself. You must be conscious, capable of the required Action, legitimately entitled to this exact activation, ready on its own recharge ledger, and able to perceive and have line of effect to the selected actual natural terrain within 15 feet. Silence, occupied hands or lack of a casting focus alone do not prohibit it. Actual suppression or a prohibition whose operative scope covers this magical technique still applies. The later investigation keeps its own senses, hands, tools, access and task requirements. A permitted borrowed activation separately requires Versatile Mastery's actual donor preparation, consent and perceived/understood signal; the technique supplies no communication channel.

No ordinary spell-rank price, spell strain surcharge, automatic spell Dissonance, Refrain update, remembered-spell-name change, Fracture ranked-cast prohibition or rank-based trauma is applied by this activation. NEW NWQ-04 commitment and area: before payment, declare this source, actor and one fixed investigation area consisting only of the actual natural terrain within 15 feet of the actor's commitment position that is then perceivable and has line of effect. Record that area and position; the area does not follow the actor and no moving aura or remote sensor is created. Actual hidden clues need not already be known or present to make an otherwise lawful investigation site eligible. Commit the legal Action and 1 RP together, set the actor's same-card Recharge counter to 3, and, for borrowing, spend the single Versatile Mastery use at that same commitment. Record donor provenance without spending any donor resource. A rejected precommit declaration spends none of these costs. Resolve the activation within that same action after only genuinely applicable source-defined interruptions; there is no automatic Counterspell window, opposed cast roll or concentration test. Ordinary Counterspell and rank-limited spell dispels do not acquire this nonspell target. If the actor cannot finish the activation or its fixed terrain is no longer legally in range, perceivable and reachable by line of effect at resolution, the paid activation fails without a new area or refund. Borrowing's donor condition is tested at actual activation commitment, not imposed as a new continuing tether after receipt of the signal.

NEW NWQ-04 rider and check: a surviving activation gives this actor one unused rider from actual resolution until resolution time plus 60 elapsed seconds; the exact deadline is not renewed by travel, turns, initiative changes, donor departure or the borrowed permission ending. No concentration is required. At most one unused Nature's Whisper rider belongs to that actor across native and borrowed uses; a new successful resolution replaces an older unused rider, not stacks or banks checks. A failed or interrupted new activation does not itself replace an older otherwise valid rider. Before any dice or outcome are supplied, voluntarily bind the rider to one separately lawful and paid Perception or Survival check about tracks, hidden natural creatures or signs of passage in the original fixed area. The relevant terrain/evidence must still be natural, within 15 feet of the actor and accessible to the task's actual senses and line of effect; no total-cover, thoughts, incorporeal-detection or automatic-revelation exception is supplied. Consume the rider at that check's outcome commitment before rolling or determining its result, even if other advantage already exists, disadvantage cancels it, the legal check fails, or a genuine interruption then prevents its result. An invalid check declaration does not consume the rider or grant a free roll. A paid longer task whose check reaches adjudication at or after the deadline receives no rider. Use ordinary task resolution and advantage cancellation; no passive-score adjustment, extra degree effect, free check, new retry or second bonus is granted. Reveal only real evidence supported by the actual successful task and observer rules; unknown data is not proof of absence. Failure does not reveal otherwise hidden facts. Expired, consumed or ended riders cannot be reclaimed by repeating a request.

Either all required allowance/resources are valid before commitment or no new setup spend occurs; a partial class/feat-ledger reservation is forbidden. HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID, actual owner, fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, paid transaction and consumed permission receipt, preparation round, affected ledger identities, original Ready expiry and any independently applicable earlier source/capture deadline. RELEASE. If nothing legal can release before expiry, the hold is lost normally. At the exact expiry boundary, expiry occurs first.

This settles only allowance/transaction timing; complete Ready scheduling, perception, source-specific payloads and live engine behavior still require implementation and tests.

Vaskor, the Stone Maw is the Gate Guardian for possibility under pressure. It is an arena-scale adversary whose body, Seal, and terrain operate as one examination. COPY-READY-ALLOWANCE-01 — NEW scoped decision for the seven FS-08/SUP-07 feat-copy profiles only. This does not change ordinary Ready, ordinary class spell cadence, the Mirrorsage class Echo implementation, any profile's payload or any acquisition predicate.

PREPARATION. A direct feat-copy cast retains its current commitment-round allowance rule. A Readied feat-copy also requires the owner's feat-copy allowance in its actual preparation numbered round. If this owner actually has the separately acquired Mirrorsage shared-release engine to which the exact source binds feat copies, require that same round's actual class allowance as well; an ability route alone never invents the engine. Validate all presently required setup predicates first. At one authoritative legal preparation commitment, atomically spend the Action, quote/payment, permission/use, feat-copy round allowance and any required actually owned class allowance, provide components, update the independent feat-copy chronological family/strain exactly once, and establish the one Ready concentration burden. These spends occur before the preparation counter window. Either all required allowance/resources are valid before commitment or no new setup spend occurs; a partial class/feat-ledger reservation is forbidden. A countered, replaced, expired or concentration-lost preparation retains its actual committed spends. It cannot refund the consumed Mimicry use, restore displaced concentration or free that preparation round for another copy. A genuinely failed precommit validation is not a paid preparation.

HELD RECORD. Bind one unique preparation ID, actual owner, fixed captured source/profile/q/mode, paid transaction and consumed permission receipt, preparation round, affected ledger identities, original Ready expiry and any independently applicable earlier source/capture deadline. A new valid Ready may replace it only under ordinary Ready; an illegal replacement attempt cannot delete it. Consuming the capture permission at preparation is not itself loss of this paid hold's authorization, but this completion does not extend a printed earlier capture/use/hold deadline or create a new permission. No allowance in a future round is reserved ahead of time. No payload or success-triggered effect has happened merely because setup was paid. Capture validity, source component availability and upstream providers still require their actual existing records; this decision is not a missing-source adapter.

RELEASE. After a real perceivable trigger has completed and before the Ready's original expiry, perform the ordinary release legality check, including an actually available lawful Reaction and all applicable source/target/geometry predicates. Check the ACTUAL RELEASE numbered round's feat-copy allowance and any actually required class shared-release allowance. In the same numbered round as preparation, reuse only this same held preparation's already-spent allowance tokens, not another copy's tokens. In a later numbered round, both applicable release-round allowances must be free and are atomically spent together with the Reaction when this release commits. The preparation-round spends are not moved, refunded or reclassified. Thus cross-round Ready deliberately occupies one attempt allowance in each touched round, but pays RP, capture permission, components, strain and casting history only once. This is the selected conservative timing choice, not a claim that the prior source already specified it. It prevents both preparation spam after a counter and a deferred copy plus a competing copy bypassing the release-round cap. An unowned class engine is still not granted.

If the trigger is declined, target is invalid, an actual prerequisite is missing or either required release-round allowance is unavailable, do not spend the Reaction or partially debit another ledger; keep the existing held record only until another lawful occurrence before its original expiry. Supply no hidden-target or item-identification diagnostic. A genuinely permitted competing direct copy or class release may use its available round allowance first; holding a prior-round copy gives no priority or override. If nothing legal can release before expiry, the hold is lost normally. At the exact expiry boundary, expiry occurs first.

On a valid release commitment, consume the hold once before resolving its one payload. No second RP/material payment, source-permission consumption, casting-family/Refrain update, ordinary cast hook or Counterspell window occurs. Later prevention of that committed payload does not refund the Reaction or release-round allowances. Replay/retry of the same release ID cannot create another payload or another spend. Immediate Strike/Burst/Mend/Step releases end the Ready concentration after resolution. Sustained Ward/Hindrance/Boon continue the same one burden with their real effect clock and earlier source limits; there is no second slot. Save/load must preserve the complete hold identity, original expiry, consumed receipts, chronology and per-owner/per-numbered-round ledger entries. Extra turns, reloading, relabeling a round, changing a qualifying route or swapping captured profile names cannot reset them. This settles only allowance/transaction timing; complete Ready scheduling, perception, source-specific payloads and live engine behavior still require implementation and tests.
